git remote -v && git branch -a && git log --oneline --all | head -40 && git merge-base HEAD origin/splitter/1108004416/r1/A 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls -la artifacts scratch 2>/dev/null; ls -la

git rev-parse HEAD origin/splitter/1110043826/r1/A && git merge-base HEAD origin/HEAD && git log --oneline origin/HEAD -3 && echo '--- parents ---' && git log -1 --format='%P %D' HEAD && git show-ref --heads | head
git merge-base HEAD origin/HEAD; echo exit:$?; git rev-parse origin/HEAD; git log --oneline -1 origin/splitter/1108004416/r1/A; git cat-file -p HEAD | head -20

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && node smoke.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke-and-checks.log && node scratch/check.ts >> /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke-and-checks.log && cat /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke-and-checks.log

cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
Open charges cap the typed refund at half the capture; settled charges cap it at the full capture. Same-day is the unsettled window (`settled`), so `ageHours` and refund history do not change the amount, and the processing fee is not subtracted because no rate is given.

<risk>
An open refund never exceeds the typed amount, even though the ticket says operations releases half the capture. A reviewer who reads that as "always half, ignore the request" will disagree on partial open refunds. Odd cents floor, so a 1-cent open capture returns 0.

<verified>
`node smoke.ts` printed `refundCents -> 0`. `node scratch/check.ts` passed settled, open, rounding, negative, and history cases.
EOF
git status && git diff --stat && git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git status && git push -u origin HEAD
